target.title: fix(agents): retry transient filesystem races when reading workspace bootstrap files
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`readWorkspaceFileWithGuards` in `src/agents/workspace.ts` reads each workspace
bootstrap file (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, HEARTBEAT.md,
BOOTSTRAP.md, MEMORY.md) with a single `openRootFile` + `readFileSync(fd)` and no
retry. On a transient filesystem race (`EAGAIN`/`EWOULDBLOCK`/`EINTR` under load)
the read throws — or `openRootFile` returns `{ ok: false, reason: "io" }` — and the
file is reported `missing`. Because `loadWorkspaceBootstrapFiles` runs **every agent
turn** (`bootstrap-cache.ts`, "Refresh per turn so long-lived sessions pick up
edits"), a transient race silently drops the agent's bootstrap content for that
turn.

This is the unmigrated sibling of the transient-race fix in
`fileContentDiffersFromTemplate`: that function already retries reads via the
`retryAsync` + `isTransientWorkspaceReadError` helpers defined in this same file,
but the guard was only wired into the onboarding template check, not the per-turn
bootstrap reader.

## Why This Change Was Made

Wrap the reader's open+read in the existing in-file `retryAsync`
(`isTransientWorkspaceReadError`, 3 attempts, 50 ms) so a transient race is retried
instead of dropping the file. The retry re-opens on each attempt rather than
re-reading the same fd: retrying `readFileSync` on an already-partially-read fd
could return truncated content, whereas a fresh open gives a clean read and
`openRootFile`'s inode-identity guard still rejects a file swapped between attempts.
Transient failures on the open itself (surfaced by `openRootFile` as
`reason: "io"`) are retried too, so the fix is not one-sided within the function.

Behavior is otherwise unchanged: deterministic path/validation failures are not
retried, and exhausted transient retries still return `{ ok: false, reason: "io" }`
(surfaced as `missing`) rather than throwing — preserving this reader's existing
contract (unlike the template check, which propagates).

## User Impact

Long-lived agent sessions no longer intermittently lose their AGENTS/SOUL/TOOLS/
HEARTBEAT bootstrap content for a turn under filesystem load; the agent keeps its
identity and instructions across transient IO races.

## Evidence

- Three regression tests in `src/agents/workspace.test.ts` drive the real
  `loadWorkspaceBootstrapFiles` production path against a real temp workspace,
  injecting a transient `EAGAIN` at the `readFileSync`/`openSync` boundary:
  - a transient read on the first attempt is retried and the real content loads
    (not `missing`);
  - a transient open failure is retried and the content loads (not `missing`);
  - exhausted transient retries surface the file as `missing` without an uncaught
    throw.
- Focused suite `src/agents/workspace.test.ts` green — vitest reports `Tests 54
  passed (54)`, including the three new cases above.
- Core typecheck (`tsgo:core`, `tsgo:core:test`) clean; formatter and linter clean.
